# Project-scoped Canvas extensions

The project-scoped extension on `main` is a committed demonstration for the
45-minute technical session. Project extensions execute local code and must
be reviewed before trust.

| Extension | Role in the talk |
|---|---|
| [`sketch-to-app/`](sketch-to-app/) | Completed shared whiteboard: human drawing and notes, agent snapshots and note actions, session-backed artifacts, and optional MAUI app build |

The smaller live-build walkthrough is
[`../../demos/first-canvas.md`](../../demos/first-canvas.md); it creates a
separate cue-card extension in the working session rather than shipping a
second prepared extension.
